Work waits on the inlet until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the timber of the next round. Reaching the sonnet of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Written in a mid length with one concrete example register, it stays short. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work.
